blocks.text: 🪝 ADB Trims India's FY27 Growth Forecast to 6.6% Amid Energy Price Concerns. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Asian Development Outlook (ADO) raises India inflation forecast sharply to 5.2%.
GDP Revision: India FY27 GDP growth revised to 6.6% (from earlier 6.9%) due to Middle East energy risks.
Inflation Forecast: Inflation forecast raised to 5.2% (from 4.5% projected in April).
ADB FY27 GDP forecast (6.6%) vs IMF FY27 GDP forecast (6.4%).
